section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study comprising 490 women from the Portuguese general population, aged 18-55 years (M = 24.76). The sample had a mean BMI of 22.29 (normal weight range), with 72.9% living in urban areas and 27.1% in rural areas. The BMI distribution matched the female Portuguese population distribution.
